t: When you are afraid of being used against your faith
a: فَقَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
p: …rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnatan li-l-qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn, wa najjinā bi-raḥmatika mina-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn.
m: So they said, "Upon Allāh do we rely. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
